prompt_text: What is the best tool for an Airbnb host to set nightly pricing and analyze a market before buying?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer
- For market analysis before buying: AirDNA (MarketMinder/Rentalizer) is the best single tool.  
- For automated nightly pricing once you list the property: PriceLabs is the best all‑round choice (highly customizable). If you prefer a simpler, set‑and‑forget option, Beyond Pricing or Wheelhouse are good alternatives.

Why those choices
- AirDNA: industry standard for pre‑purchase research — neighborhood-level occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, seasonality, listing density, and revenue estimators (Rentalizer). It lets you quickly compare neighborhoods and run conservative revenue scenarios before buying.
- PriceLabs: powerful, flexible rules engine (minimum/maximum, custom adjustments by date, length‑of‑stay, lead time, events), good market data, and wide integrations with channel managers and Airbnb. That flexibility usually produces higher revenue than simple “smart pricing.”
- Beyond Pricing/Wheelhouse: easier to set up and more automated; good if you want fewer manual tweaks.

What to look for in any tool
- Integration with Airbnb and/or your PMS/channel manager
- Granularity (neighborhood/zip code level, property type)
- Seasonality & event detection
- Min/max price and rule-based overrides
- Occupancy, ADR and RevPAR historical charts
- Ease of use and customer support
- Cost model (monthly per listing vs percentage of bookings)

Practical workflow (how to use them before buying)
1. Use AirDNA MarketMinder for the target area: check occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, seasonality, length‑of‑stay, and listing growth over recent years. Use Rentalizer to estimate realistic revenue given your property type and comps.
2. Map supply/demand: density of listings, nearby hotels, regulation hotspots, and event calendar.
3. Do a conservative cash‑flow model: estimate operating costs, vacancy, cleaning, management fees, taxes and cap rate under different occupancy/ADR scenarios.
4. If buying looks promising, sign up for a short trial of PriceLabs (or Beyond Pricing) and run its market settings against your comps to simulate expected nightly prices and monthly revenue.
5. Confirm legal/regulatory compliance and local zoning/HOA rules.

A few alternatives
- Mashvisor: cheaper, less granular than AirDNA but OK for initial screening.  
- Transparent / AllTheRooms: enterprise/agency level market intelligence.  
- Airbnb Smart Pricing: free but less flexible and less revenue‑focused than the paid tools.

Costs (brief)
- AirDNA, PriceLabs, Beyond Pricing and Wheelhouse each use different pricing models (monthly subscriptions, per‑market fees, or % of revenue). Check current pricing on their sites; many offer trials or pay‑as‑you‑go market reports.

Recommendation
- If you can only pick one tool before buying: use AirDNA for market analysis.  
- If you need to automate pricing after listing: use PriceLabs (or Beyond Pricing if you want simpler setup).  
If you want, tell me the city/neighborhood you’re considering and a short description of the property (type, size, target guest), and I’ll suggest specific AirDNA metrics to check and a pricing setup example.
